wrapper.footer.title: We've got your devices covered:
wrapper.footer.subtitle: We have guides on how to use the client
wrapper.subtitle: Optimize your connection, choose the best servers, and control your gaming experience
marker.features.subtitle: Everything you need for the best gaming experience
quickstart.windows.step1.title: Download and install the app
quickstart.windows.step1.description: Download the installer from the GitHub releases section and run it. Follow the setup wizard instructions.
quickstart.android.step1.title: Download APK and install the app
quickstart.android.step1.description: Download the APK file from the GitHub releases section and install it.
quickstart.windows.step2.title: Run as Administrator
quickstart.windows.step2.description: To enable server blocking features, launch the application with administrator privileges:
quickstart.windows.step2.footer: The application cannot access the hosts file without administrator rights.
quickstart.windows.step2.list.set_run_ad: Or configure the shortcut to always run as administrator
quickstart.android.step2.title: Select region
quickstart.android.step2.description: Select your game region at the very top of the main screen. The clusters for that region will appear at the bottom.
quickstart.android.step2.footer: Tip: Servers with ping under 50ms are marked green, 50-100ms yellow, and above 100ms red.
quickstart.windows.step3.title: Select region and server
quickstart.windows.step3.description: In the main window, choose your game region and a server with the lowest ping (indicated in green).
quickstart.windows.step3.footer: Tip: Servers with ping under 50ms are marked green, 50-100ms yellow, and above 100ms red.
quickstart.android.step3.title: Configure blocking and launch the game
quickstart.android.step3.description: Check the clusters you want to block, then tap the lock button in the center of the screen until it turns green or the status displays 'Blocking enabled'. After that, launch the game.
quickstart.windows.step4.title: Configure blocking and launch the game
quickstart.windows.step4.description: Check the clusters you want to block and click 'Update Block'. Then launch the game using the 'Play' button or via its shortcut.
